LanguageData.OL_Editor_Note: Pawns wear the best allowed piece, top line first.
LanguageData.OL_Editor_Help: Pawns compare clothes on the first line, then the next. Lines can also rule pieces out.
LanguageData.OL_Editor_BaseTip: Use another policy's priorities and locks under this one's.
LanguageData.OL_Editor_CoversTip: As the info card's "Covers" lists it. The head is one part, so a hat covers the full head.
LanguageData.OL_Editor_CoverageDirectionTip: Click to choose: required or not allowed.
LanguageData.OL_Editor_OnlyWhatHelpsTip: Only put on pieces that help a priority, plus cover and warmth. With no priorities, nothing new.
LanguageData.OL_Editor_DirectionTip: Higher or lower first, or at least / at most a value.
LanguageData.OL_CountsFrom_Tip: Amounts below this count as none.
LanguageData.OL_CountsFrom_Highest: The most any apparel has is {0}.
LanguageData.OL_LayerPicker_LastTip: Keep at least one layer ticked.
LanguageData.OL_Layer_Tip: The layers this line counts on.
LanguageData.OL_Editor_LockedItemTip: Preferred over anything not locked. Remove the line to unlock.
LanguageData.OL_Editor_LocksFirst: Locked items stay above the stats.
LanguageData.OL_Lock_KeptAllowed: {0} is locked, so it stays allowed. Unlock it first.
LanguageData.OL_Editor_Empty: No priorities yet. Pawns pick clothes the usual way.
LanguageData.OL_Editor_EmptyNothingNew: No priorities yet. Pawns put nothing new on.
LanguageData.OL_Rule_RequiredTip: Prefer pieces that cover {0} while it's bare.
LanguageData.OL_Rule_ValueTip: Pieces past this are ruled out.
LanguageData.OL_Rule_Tip: Ranks like higher or lower first, and forbids pieces past the value. Locked items are never forbidden.
LanguageData.OL_StatPicker_ChangedBy: {0} apparel items give this to their wearer.
LanguageData.OL_StatPicker_HadBy: {0} apparel items have a value for this.
